note: Bands on the share of bot time each kind of activity gets in a gauntlet scenario (docs/architecture/bots.md, Tuning). Nothing dormant, nothing dominant: under min while offered is DORMANT, over max is DOMINANT. Behaviours, goof and vehicle share bot time; an option (aim:feet) shares its choice point's time. Only an enforced edge (floor, ceiling or both) fails a test; the rest report. Tighten a band with the measured value in its note.

fight.note: Enforced floor: a bot offered a fight takes it. Measured 7% (jeep, of all time) to 94% (deathmatch). The ceiling flags one-note deathmatches.

objective.note: Enforced floor: a bot offered an objective plays it. Measured 76% (CTF) to 100% (race).

vehicle.note: Mounted time; offered where a seat is (interact). Measured 78% (jeep).

wander.note: Strolling. Idle scenarios change the ceiling.

goof.note: Flavour interrupts; offered at a pause (wander). DORMANT while surprise.strength is 0.

aim:feet.note: Splash aims, of aiming time, where offered.

route:left.note: Flanking chases, of chase-route time, where offered.

wander.note: Nobody to fight: a long pause by design.
